name: AuditAE REST API
description: Check whether AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode) cite a brand, crawl a site, and generate or validate schema.org JSON-LD. Prepaid credit: paid calls draw from the workspace balance, free calls never do. When the balance is too low, a paid call answers 402 with a `top_up` request (POST /api/v1/billing/top-up). Authenticate with an ae_live_… key from https://auditae.app/dashboard/keys. The same tools are on the MCP server at https://auditae.app/api/mcp.
